[package]
name = "agents"
version = "0.1.6"
edition = "2024"
license = "MIT"
description = "Agent command center for Claude Code sessions"
publish = false

[[bin]]
name = "agents"
path = "src/main.rs"

[dependencies]
arboard = { version = "3", default-features = false, features = ["image-data"] }
base64 = "0.23"
chrono = "0.4"
crossterm = "0.29"
image = { version = "0.25", default-features = false, features = ["png", "jpeg", "gif", "webp", "bmp", "tiff"] }
libc = "0.2"
notify = "7"
nucleo-matcher = "0.3"
plist = "1"
pulldown-cmark = { version = "0.10", default-features = false }
roxmltree = "0.21.1"
ratatui = { version = "0.30", default-features = false, features = ["crossterm", "unstable-widget-ref"] }
rusqlite = { version = "0.38", features = ["bundled"] }
serde = { version = "1", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1"
shlex = "2"
syntect = { version = "5", default-features = false, features = ["default-fancy"] }
tempfile = "3"
textwrap = "0.16"
two-face = { version = "0.5", default-features = false, features = ["syntect-default-fancy"] }
tungstenite = { version = "0.28", default-features = false, features = ["handshake"] }
unicode-segmentation = "1"
unicode-width = "0.2"
url = "2"
uuid = { version = "1", features = ["v4"] }
ureq = { version = "3", default-features = false, features = ["rustls"] }
vt100 = "0.16"
vte = "0.15"
sha2 = "0.10"

# macOS's default `unpacked` keeps one .o per codegen unit in target/debug/deps for
# every incremental build, and Gatekeeper lists that directory on each exec of a test
# binary; past ~100k entries syspolicyd pins several cores. Applies to `test` too.
[profile.dev]
split-debuginfo = "off"

# Grammar regexes compile lazily on first use. Keep their engine optimized in
# development and tests, as syntect does in its own development profile.
[profile.dev.package.aho-corasick]
opt-level = 2

[profile.dev.package.fancy-regex]
opt-level = 2

[profile.dev.package.regex-automata]
opt-level = 2

[profile.dev.package.regex-syntax]
opt-level = 2

[patch.crates-io]
nucleo-matcher = { path = "vendor/nucleo-matcher" }
crossterm = { git = "https://github.com/blockchainian/crossterm", rev = "03622784292936a1950cfae866c02f584c21b848" }

# AGENTS.md

> The user runs the installed `agents`, never the source.

This directory is `agents`, the Rust terminal dashboard for Claude Code and Codex sessions, with prompt input and Claude background task creation.

## Modules

- src/app.rs -- the terminal loop: input, refresh and actions
- src/model.rs -- sessions as the dashboard sees them
- src/providers/ -- session readers and controls: `claude`, `codex`
- src/sessions/ -- merged snapshots and filesystem notifications
- src/processes.rs -- running processes and their open files, read through libproc
- src/event.rs -- task events and filters
- src/usage.rs -- a transcript's token usage in time bins, for the usage chart
- src/activity.rs -- when a transcript's turns ran, for the activity strip
- src/jsonl.rs -- a growing transcript read by complete lines, forward or backward
- src/tasks.rs -- task worktrees, environment files and workspace trust
- src/ui/ -- rendering, prompt input, drafts and the task event panels
- tests/ -- real payload fixtures and rendered UI snapshots

## Development

- A rendering change updates the snapshots it moves in `tests/ui_snapshots/`.

## Tools

### Install

- `cargo install --path . --locked` — builds and installs the current source

## Checks

The gate every change passes:

- **tests**: `cargo nextest run`
- **lint**: `cargo clippy --all-targets`
- **build**: `cargo build --release`

## Tests

> Run coverage tests only when you need coverage.

- Run the relevant tests.
- **coverage tests**: `cargo llvm-cov nextest --no-fail-fast --html`

## Version control

- Commit and push, then install the binary in the same turn.
# AGENTS.md

> Before working in a plugin, read its `README.md`.  
> Never hard-code a path of this machine: the repo is public.  
> Never import a plugin script by its versioned cache path.

This repo is the `blockchainian` plugin marketplace for Claude Code and Codex, and the only home of all its plugins.

## Modules

- .claude-plugin/ -- the Claude Code catalog
- .agents/plugins/ -- the Codex catalog
- plugins/ -- one directory per plugin
- agents/ -- `agents`, the Rust session dashboard
- git/ -- `git`, the VS Code extension that opens a commit, a repository folder or a pull request from a `vscode://blockchainian.git/` link
- tests/ -- the marketplace suite

## Development

- Name tools by what they do.
- A tool offers the capability up to its hard limit; callers decide budgets.
- A tool supports only its current data format; no compat code.

## Checks

The per-plugin gate a plan's `Checks` command composes:

- **validate**: `npm run validate`
- **tests**: `npm run test:<plugin>`

## Tests

> Run the relevant tests.

- `npm test` — every suite
- `npm run test:marketplace` — the marketplace manifest and shared-engine checks
- `npm run test:codex` — codex-manager against a fake app-server daemon
- `npm run test:feature` — the feature plugin's plan checkers, workstream.sh, watch-ci and retro
- `npm run test:proxy` — the capture logic and WireGuard key derivation
- `npm run test:intel` — the intel skills; the render suites need Chrome and uv
- `npm run test:web` — the heap-snapshot diff and the design check; needs uv
- `npm run test:mobile` — the phone-session hook, simulator claim, frame diff, stitch and design check; needs uv
- `npm run test:secrets` — the local secrets engine and adapter contract
- `npm run test:creator` — account pick, args, stats and sound rows
- `npm run test:computer-use` — the window capture
- `npm run test:agents` — the `agents` dashboard

## Version control

- Bump the plugin's version in the same commit as the change; keep its manifest versions equal.
- Commit and push to main, then update the installed plugin.

## Tools

### Install

> Install, update and uninstall plugins at user scope only.

- `claude plugin marketplace update blockchainian` — fetches the pushed catalog
- `claude plugin update <plugin>@blockchainian` — installs the bumped version

### Set up

- Add a new plugin dir to Codex `writable_roots` in `~/.codex/config.toml`.

# AGENTS.md

> The user runs the installed `agents`, never the source.

This directory is `agents`, the Rust terminal dashboard for Claude Code and Codex sessions, with prompt input and Claude background task creation.

## Modules

- src/app.rs -- the terminal loop: input, refresh and actions
- src/model.rs -- sessions as the dashboard sees them
- src/providers/ -- session readers and controls: `claude`, `codex`
- src/sessions/ -- merged snapshots and filesystem notifications
- src/processes.rs -- running processes and their open files, read through libproc
- src/event.rs -- task events and filters
- src/usage.rs -- a transcript's token usage in time bins, for the usage chart
- src/activity.rs -- when a transcript's turns ran, for the activity strip
- src/jsonl.rs -- a growing transcript read by complete lines, forward or backward
- src/tasks.rs -- task worktrees, environment files and workspace trust
- src/ui/ -- rendering, prompt input, drafts and the task event panels
- tests/ -- real payload fixtures and rendered UI snapshots

## Development

- A rendering change updates the snapshots it moves in `tests/ui_snapshots/`.

## Tools

### Install

- `cargo install --path . --locked` — builds and installs the current source

## Checks

The gate every change passes:

- **tests**: `cargo nextest run`
- **lint**: `cargo clippy --all-targets`
- **build**: `cargo build --release`

## Tests

> Run coverage tests only when you need coverage.

- Run the relevant tests.
- **coverage tests**: `cargo llvm-cov nextest --no-fail-fast --html`

## Version control

- Commit and push, then install the binary in the same turn.
# AGENTS.md

> Before working in a plugin, read its `README.md`.  
> Never hard-code a path of this machine: the repo is public.  
> Never import a plugin script by its versioned cache path.

This repo is the `blockchainian` plugin marketplace for Claude Code and Codex, and the only home of all its plugins.

## Modules

- .claude-plugin/ -- the Claude Code catalog
- .agents/plugins/ -- the Codex catalog
- plugins/ -- one directory per plugin
- agents/ -- `agents`, the Rust session dashboard
- git/ -- `git`, the VS Code extension that opens a commit, a repository folder or a pull request from a `vscode://blockchainian.git/` link
- tests/ -- the marketplace suite

## Development

- Name tools by what they do.
- A tool offers the capability up to its hard limit; callers decide budgets.
- A tool supports only its current data format; no compat code.

## Checks

The per-plugin gate a plan's `Checks` command composes:

- **validate**: `npm run validate`
- **tests**: `npm run test:<plugin>`

## Tests

> Run the relevant tests.

- `npm test` — every suite
- `npm run test:marketplace` — the marketplace manifest and shared-engine checks
- `npm run test:codex` — codex-manager against a fake app-server daemon
- `npm run test:feature` — the feature plugin's plan checkers, workstream.sh, watch-ci and retro
- `npm run test:proxy` — the capture logic and WireGuard key derivation
- `npm run test:intel` — the intel skills; the render suites need Chrome and uv
- `npm run test:web` — the heap-snapshot diff and the design check; needs uv
- `npm run test:mobile` — the phone-session hook, simulator claim, frame diff, stitch and design check; needs uv
- `npm run test:secrets` — the local secrets engine and adapter contract
- `npm run test:creator` — account pick, args, stats and sound rows
- `npm run test:computer-use` — the window capture
- `npm run test:agents` — the `agents` dashboard

## Version control

- Bump the plugin's version in the same commit as the change; keep its manifest versions equal.
- Commit and push to main, then update the installed plugin.

## Tools

### Install

> Install, update and uninstall plugins at user scope only.

- `claude plugin marketplace update blockchainian` — fetches the pushed catalog
- `claude plugin update <plugin>@blockchainian` — installs the bumped version

### Set up

- Add a new plugin dir to Codex `writable_roots` in `~/.codex/config.toml`.

+- `claude plugin update <plugin>@blockchainian` — installs the bumped version
+
+### Set up
 
-- Commit and push, then install the binary in the same turn.
+- Add a new plugin dir to Codex `writable_roots` in `~/.codex/config.toml`.

[package]
name = "agents"
version = "0.1.6"
edition = "2024"
license = "MIT"
description = "Agent command center for Claude Code sessions"
publish = false

[[bin]]
name = "agents"
path = "src/main.rs"

[dependencies]
arboard = { version = "3", default-features = false, features = ["image-data"] }
base64 = "0.23"
chrono = "0.4"
crossterm = "0.29"
image = { version = "0.25", default-features = false, features = ["png", "jpeg", "gif", "webp", "bmp", "tiff"] }
libc = "0.2"
notify = "7"
nucleo-matcher = "0.3"
plist = "1"
pulldown-cmark = { version = "0.10", default-features = false }
roxmltree = "0.21.1"
ratatui = { version = "0.30", default-features = false, features = ["crossterm", "unstable-widget-ref"] }
rusqlite = { version = "0.38", features = ["bundled"] }
serde = { version = "1", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1"
shlex = "2"
syntect = { version = "5", default-features = false, features = ["default-fancy"] }
tempfile = "3"
textwrap = "0.16"
two-face = { version = "0.5", default-features = false, features = ["syntect-default-fancy"] }
tungstenite = { version = "0.28", default-features = false, features = ["handshake"] }
unicode-segmentation = "1"
unicode-width = "0.2"
url = "2"
uuid = { version = "1", features = ["v4"] }
ureq = { version = "3", default-features = false, features = ["rustls"] }
vt100 = "0.16"
vte = "0.15"
sha2 = "0.10"

version = "0.1.6"
edition = "2024"
license = "MIT"
description = "Agent command center for Claude Code sessions"
publish = false

[[bin]]
name = "agents"
path = "src/main.rs"

[dependencies]
arboard = { version = "3", default-features = false, features = ["image-data"] }
base64 = "0.23"
chrono = "0.4"
crossterm = "0.29"
image = { version = "0.25", default-features = false, features = ["png", "jpeg", "gif", "webp", "bmp", "tiff"] }
libc = "0.2"
notify = "7"
nucleo-matcher = "0.3"
plist = "1"
pulldown-cmark = { version = "0.10", default-features = false }
roxmltree = "0.21.1"
ratatui = { version = "0.30", default-features = false, features = ["crossterm", "unstable-widget-ref"] }
rusqlite = { version = "0.38", features = ["bundled"] }
serde = { version = "1", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1"
shlex = "2"
syntect = { version = "5", default-features = false, features = ["default-fancy"] }
tempfile = "3"
textwrap = "0.16"
two-face = { version = "0.5", default-features = false, features = ["syntect-default-fancy"] }
tungstenite = { version = "0.28", default-features = false, features = ["handshake"] }
unicode-segmentation = "1"
unicode-width = "0.2"
url = "2"
uuid = { version = "1", features = ["v4"] }
ureq = { version = "3", default-features = false, features = ["rustls"] }
vt100 = "0.16"
vte = "0.15"
sha2 = "0.10"

# macOS's default `unpacked` keeps one .o per codegen unit in target/debug/deps for
# every incremental build, and Gatekeeper lists that directory on each exec of a test
# binary; past ~100k entries syspolicyd pins several cores. Applies to `test` too.
[profile.dev]
split-debuginfo = "off"

# Grammar regexes compile lazily on first use. Keep their engine optimized in
# development and tests, as syntect does in its own development profile.
[profile.dev.package.aho-corasick]
opt-level = 2

[profile.dev.package.fancy-regex]
opt-level = 2

[profile.dev.package.regex-automata]
opt-level = 2

[profile.dev.package.regex-syntax]
opt-level = 2

[patch.crates-io]
nucleo-matcher = { path = "vendor/nucleo-matcher" }
crossterm = { git = "https://github.com/blockchainian/crossterm", rev = "03622784292936a1950cfae866c02f584c21b848" }
